current.text: He is the backup center behind Domantas Sabonis, who is the projected starter.
Experts expect him to play about 19 to 20 minutes a night in that role.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a knee injury.
He produced top-70 value over the last two months of last season, when many Kings injuries opened a big role for him.
His upside depends on Sabonis being traded or hurt. Experts say he cannot do much in limited minutes and will have little value early.

Some experts think the Kings may trade or dump Sabonis, but Josh does not expect a trade, and experts do not expect the Kings to bench Sabonis for him while the team needs wins to stay out of the relegation zone.
Lloyd expects the Kings to trade or sit their veterans and finish near the bottom, which is the main path to a bigger role for him.
Ham thinks he could be better than Sabonis in two to three years and says the Kings should try to show he is a starter this season.
Josh says he is not the best per-minute producer among backup centers, and that Paul Reed is far better per minute.
Experts advise against drafting him in a 12-team league. The newest call sees no point in drafting a backup center who is not that good.
In Summer League he took 39% of his shots from three and blocked no shots.
A rising three-point rate would lower his FG% but add points and threes. Experts say to keep an eye on it.

durable.text: He shoots efficiently from the field and the line for a center and makes some threes at a good rate.
He is not a shot blocker. His blocks are low for a center.
Steals are his weakest category, low even for a center.

note: Yahoo ranks him 161st with a 1.0 USD average cost, and he went undrafted in our league last season. With only 144 players drafted, he belongs on waivers, not on draft day. His efficient FG% and low turnovers would help a punt STL build if he got starter minutes, as he did over the last two months of last season. Early in the season, watch his knee (Yahoo Q), any Sabonis trade or injury news, and whether his three-point rate is rising.
